opportunity.title: Sizing Technology Pilot (Army Call for Solutions)
opportunity.noticeType: Solicitation (Call for Solutions under Army Open Solicitation W9128Z-25-S-A002)
opportunity.description: Army Contracting Command-Aberdeen Proving Ground, on behalf of HQDA G-4, seeks mature commercial technology that captures body and foot measurements by automated non-contact methods and translates them into recommended standard Army uniform and footwear sizes. Current manual tape measurement at accession points causes bottlenecks and high uniform and boot return rates and keeps no record of sizing changes over time. Evaluation phases and required attributes are in Attachment 1. Questions were due Oct 13 2026. No set-aside used.

profile.pastPerformance: Service-disabled veteran-owned. Prime on two VA software maintenance contracts (about $2.1M and $3.4M) and one Army National Guard web portal ($650K).
profile.capacityNotes: Twenty-two staff. Active facility clearance (Secret). SOC 2 Type II report current. Strong VA customer references.
verification: NAICS codes confirmed against USAspending reference (api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/references/naics) on 2026-10-16.
Set-asides follow SBA definitions: SBA = small business, 8A = 8(a) Business Development, HUBZONE, WOSB/EDWOSB, SDVOSB.

checks.reason: Full and open competition; no set-aside required.
NAICS 541512 is in the company's codes.
Place of performance is not stated in the notice; verify before bidding.

supportedClaims.text: The opportunity is issued by the U.S. Army Aberdeen Proving Ground in Maryland for a Sizing Technology Pilot.
The requirement seeks mature commercial technology that automatically captures body and foot measurements without contact to recommend uniform and footwear sizes.
The estimated contract value ranges from $100K to $500K.
The anticipated award size ($100K–$500K) is far below recent DoD NAICS 541512 awards exceeding $800M, indicating limited revenue potential.

droppedClaims.text: Recent DoD NAICS 541512 awards include Raytheon’s $1,076,035,500 and Accenture Federal Services’ $896,468,884 contracts.
droppedClaims.reason: relevance check: not relevant to this opportunity (Award details are present but unrelated to this opportunity's bid decision.)

rationale.point: Company holds NAICS 541512 and place of performance MD matches Aberdeen Proving Ground location (claim #1, profile).
Company has prior Army experience (Army National Guard web portal $650K) and active Secret clearance, supporting eligibility.
Requirement seeks mature commercial technology for contactless body/foot measurement (claim #2), which is not evidenced in company's past performance (software maintenance, web portal).
Estimated value $100K–$500K (claim #3) aligns with company's capacity but is far below typical DoD NAICS 541512 awards (claim #4), suggesting limited revenue potential and full-and-open competition.

risks: Technical mismatch: no demonstrated capability in sizing/measurement technology (claim #2).
No set-aside: full-and-open competition against larger firms (claim #4, opportunity set-aside NONE).
Limited revenue potential relative to NAICS award history (claim #4).
nextSteps: Assess whether company can meet technical requirements with existing staff or via teaming arrangement.
Evaluate competitive landscape for this specific Call for Solutions.
Determine if pilot could lead to follow-on production contracts.

classification.summary: The Army needs a mature commercial technology that automatically captures body and foot measurements without contact to generate recommended uniform and footwear sizes, reducing bottlenecks and return rates.
